title: 七年时间、三个阶段，“想做自己真正喜欢的东西”，对话《王者万象棋》制作人
author: 王琳茜
text:
9月10日，《王者万象棋》正式开服，上线首日稳居免费榜第1、畅销榜第9，次日升至畅销榜第5。
上线后，《王者万象棋》持续稳居App Store免费榜榜首，畅销榜最高到TOP5
《王者万象棋》无疑是一款各方面给人的感觉都很“新”的游戏。这种“新”既直观地体现在玩法上，还体现在它各方面传达出的气质，比如游戏架构上简洁优美，美术资产潮酷，商业化比较克制。你很容易可以推断，它的制作团队大概率也是一支很有活力，也十分大胆的团队。
与此同时，作为“王者荣耀”IP产品之一，《王者万象棋》也有很多值得玩味的地方：它的制作人Donny是《王者荣耀》最早的策划之一；它看起来脱胎于《王者荣耀》在2019年上线、一度受到不少玩家好评的“王者模拟战”，但最后的呈现却和传统自走棋玩法天差地别。
后来我了解到，《王者万象棋》的团队规模并不大。与此同时，在整个腾讯产品的大背景中，《王者万象棋》的诞生历程也相当特殊：如果仅从项目本身的研发来说，从确立玩法到测试上线，它的进度其实相当之快，只用了2年；但在这之前，从“要做一个王者IP的策略对战游戏”的闪念，到付诸行动的好几个尝试与弯路，制作人Donny花了整整7年。
原班人马自研的《王者万象棋》
就在前段时间，触乐和Donny进行了一次采访。采访的开头，我们询问《王者万象棋》的研发历程，Donny的第一反应是笑着看向身边的同事：“这个可真的是很长的故事了。我昨天晚上刚跟他讲了一遍，但没讲完，讲了好久才讲到2024年。”
在此前的另一次线下采访中，Donny也保持了相同的状态，他放松、健谈，讲起自己的想法很容易滔滔不绝。而且，因为曾经参与《王者荣耀》的策划工作，和Donny的交流话题总会在一些时候折返回到与《王者荣耀》有关的回忆——有意思的地方在于，这些回忆在很多时候也能和《王者万象棋》的诞生形成对照。
Donny告诉触乐，《王者万象棋》的诞生是一个曲折但也幸运的故事。在他看来，这种曲折可能也是游戏研发的常态，但幸运之处在于，他有足够多的想法和支持自己的领导、同事，也一直在做“自己真正想做的东西”。
■ 01
Donny已经有相当长一段时间没有接受正式的对外采访。
他上次有印象的采访还在2018年前后：《王者荣耀》刚刚上线大约两年，但已经“取得了大家都没想到的一些成绩”，一些媒体在那段时间来到天美总部，采访当时的主创团队。彼时Donny的对外身份是“《王者荣耀》助理制作人”，也是在微博上积极和玩家交流的策划。当时，他在采访中分享的话题大多关于《王者荣耀》的诞生过程、对用户的理解以及对游戏的热爱。
也是在那段时间，“想要做一个王者IP的新游戏”的想法产生了，最开始只是一个模糊的、被提报给领导的新项目。新项目的具体构思和来源相当感性：主要因为Donny自己的爱好，他喜欢《昆特牌》《游戏王》等策略游戏，所以下意识地也想做一款“王者”IP的策略游戏。
《王者万象棋》制作人Donny
他开始把目光投向了自走棋品类。当时自走棋品类刚刚起步，Donny第一时间产生了兴趣，立刻在《王者荣耀》团队里拉了一些同事，想做一款“王者”的自走棋——也就是后来的“王者模拟战”。
“我当时觉得做自走棋非常‘有感觉’。”Donny说，这种感觉不仅来自于“做一款新游戏”的成就感，还来自于另一种在他看来相当重要的意义和价值。
“我想，之前我们做游戏一直是跟在外国人后面走，因为他们的游戏行业发展比我们要早几十年。我们是一直属于一个追赶者，很多游戏在积淀上就差了一些。”Donny说，“但自走棋不是这样的。当时，不管是拳头还是V社、暴雪，还是我们——都在相同的起步阶段，我们终于可以和国内外厂商在同一起跑线上面，做同一个品类，公平比拼，看看谁做的产品能成。我觉得这个太有感觉了。”
■ 02
虽然有了这些“很有感觉”的想法，也一度有些“热血沸腾”过。但实际上，在自走棋竞争最白热化的那两年，Donny幻想中的“同台竞争”并没有完全实现。
其中的主要原因或许在于“王者模拟战”的定位，这个模式虽然确实取得了不错的玩家数据，但依然属于《王者荣耀》的内置玩法，并没有清晰独立的发展方式和途径。因此，Donny在这之后不久，开始投入了另一个“王者”IP项目。这是一个完全独立的项目，Donny作为项目制作人。新项目的玩法和卡牌品类有些关联，但研发过程不太顺利。
“在项目做了大概一年的时候，我们已经做出来了一些东西，但是在我看来不够好玩。”他说，“我做得很纠结，左右脑一直在打架。然后，我做了个有点‘自作主张’的决定。”
这个决定指的是，将新项目的方向完全转变。Donny把所有团队成员都拉到一起，大家一起畅聊，反复沟通了很久。他对同事们讲了改变原本的项目方向可能会有哪些风险，也可能有哪些收益，还讲了自己为什么想要“follow my heart”。
“我觉得可能确实会有很多风险和不稳定性。”Donny对我说，“但是当时我想，我还是想要做自己喜欢的、好玩的游戏。”
这次项目内部会的最终结果是，大家一起决定：要做全新的方向，花3个月搓一个新Demo，然后去找老板做汇报。
■ 03
可以先说一个好的结果：那个全新的Demo并没有遭到老板的批评，反而获得了一些“既然想做那就去做吧”的支持。这给了Donny很大的鼓励。
但这款Demo也并不是我们现在看到的《王者万象棋》。因为在这次之后，他们又走了不少弯路。
在对外公开的视角里，《王者万象棋》的首次曝光时间是2022年的“王者荣耀”共创之夜。2022年4月，《王者万象棋》开启了第一次内测，随后以每3个月一次测试的频率进行了为期一年的测试。但到2023年4月，Donny发现了新的问题。
《王者万象棋》的名字带有一种“万象更新”的感觉
《王者万象棋》吸取了很多来自“王者模拟战”的经验，虽有一些创新，但整体还是没有跳出传统自走棋框架，很多玩法问题显露出来。这让Donny意识到，他们想要去面对市场，似乎必须要再做一次大改，“摸索出一条没有人尝试过的道路”。
“那时候是我压力特别大的时候。”Donny说，“……我很担心同事们没有信心和我再尝试一次。”
但Donny还是下定了决心。他形容这有点像在玩棋牌竞技，“只有翻牌到最后，你才会知道自己手里的牌是多大。但很多时候我们在前面就弃牌了，因为对方的数太大了，你不敢跟。但是我想要把这个牌翻出来，我想要知道结果到底是怎么样的。”
“如果选择了放弃，那就没有任何结果，时间也被浪费了。别人不知道你在做些什么，你做的东西没有面向用户，我觉得是一件很难接受的事情。”
■ 04
2018年，Donny想要做一款“王者”IP的策略卡牌游戏；2019年，他做了“王者模拟战”；后来他尝试过新的项目，再后来启动了《王者万象棋》。现在，他又要做一个和过去完全不同的《王者万象棋》。一个想法天然地出现了：能不能尝试一下，把这些过去的经验、策略卡牌的要素和自走棋做一些结合？
Donny不止一次提到，他非常喜欢策略卡牌游戏。但他也知道，策略卡牌游戏有一个天然的痛点，那就是1v1的对局机制，“输赢都只能怪自己，没有任何可以甩锅的对象，所以很难做出一款大众的游戏”。
“我会想，如果把上面那些玩法要素结合到一起，是不是既能够解决策略卡牌的一些痛点，又能够给策略品类带来新鲜感？”他说，“当时我不知道能不能走通，但我们还是决定试一试。”
后续的尝试确实比之前的几次都更加大胆了。Donny和团队成员们大刀阔斧地改了很多东西，形成了一个初步的“打牌+自走棋”的方案：卡牌被发到玩家手上，玩家拿着牌，用打牌的方式来玩自走棋，英雄会自动战斗。
最终呈现的《王者万象棋》有非常多“卡牌”的要素
这是全新的《王者万象棋》的第一个版本，和现在公测的版本其实也有很大差别。但是这个版本已经给了Donny一些信心：“我们感觉好像可以跑通，这里面的玩法逻辑能够形成闭环，而且也是比较有乐趣的。”
打磨了一段时间过后，新版本的《王者万象棋》在2024年4月进行了首次测试。测试的活跃度还不错，但很多玩家都不太理解产品为什么要做如此巨大的改动。
“很多玩家问我们，你们明明之前已经做得挺好了，为什么要换方向？”但同时Donny也注意到，有一部分玩家觉得游戏是有新意的，“尤其是有些第一次接触这个玩法的玩家，他们的接受度比我们想象中高很多。”这带给了他和团队很大信心。
很多新人玩家会在游玩过程中感受到《王者万象棋》刷牌、阵容搭配的乐趣
“然后我们就在这个基础上，一步步地修改里面的东西。比如从发牌，变成商店；从60级的等级上限，到999级；还有加上拍卖系统，等等。”每三个月，他们更新一个新的版本，拿出去对外测试，然后再后来继续调整、优化，然后再测试、再看数据。2024年测了3次，2025年又测了4次，今年年中又做了一次较大规模的测试。期间，玩家反馈也越来越好。
《王者万象棋》开发过程中被反复推敲后加入的拍卖系统，给很多玩家留下了深刻印象
“从去年年中开始，我们觉得，这个核心玩法已经基本稳住了。而且这是一个完全由我们自己摸索出来的一条路，这让我非常有成就感。”Donny说。
■ 05
确定了新的核心玩法的《王者万象棋》，推进速度相当之快。某种程度上，正是因为那种不断尝试、改变的基底，才让项目成员都变成了“真的喜欢这款游戏的人”，每个人的想法都开始抒发，有了真正的“创作”的感觉。
比如，游戏里的美术表现，测试期间出圈的王者英雄击杀表情包，很多都是主美和成员们自发构想出来的；也有很多小的细节改进来自于玩家的反馈，社区的启发，这些内容都可以随时被拿出来讨论。
《王者万象棋》的击杀表情包很有张力，在测试阶段就得到了非常多玩家的好评和自发传播
再比如被很多玩家津津乐道的游戏演出效果，很多人想不到，在一年之前，演出效果还是这款游戏的短板。“我们觉得刷牌、选天赋都是很有乐趣的玩法，但好像呈现到游戏里有点‘干’。”Donny说，“后面我们开了一个专项，拉着团队一起集思广益，讨论哪些地方可以让用户觉得很爽，哪些表演可以更华丽和炫酷。”
在《王者万象棋》中，玩家可以打出异常华丽的演出效果，这一点受到了不少玩家的好评
Donny把《王者万象棋》的开发过程分成三个大的阶段，起初是“王者模拟战”，然后是尝试新项目的阶段，最后是从正式确定名字，再到重新开始的阶段。
这些阶段彼此之间的连通性并不紧密，但很珍贵的一点在于，基本在每个阶段，他都在行为、选择和态度上最大限度地保留了一些执拗的追求，“要做自己喜欢的、有乐趣的游戏”，“想要在职业生涯留下一些东西”。
“好玩”、“爽”和“上头”都是很多玩家对《王者万象棋》最直观的感受
值得一提的是，在采访的过程中，我和Donny也几次聊到《王者荣耀》——实际上，在《王者荣耀》上线前夕，他们其实也做了很多类似的、此前市场上没有产品做过的决策。这些决策都来自一些同样的理念，那就是不管其他产品通用的做法是什么，他们都想先按照自己认可的方向去做。
“这样可能会有一些风险，但也会有新的生机。”Donny说，“我想做真正的喜欢的东西，即使它可能看起来有点小众，有点风险，况且市场趋势的变化很难在开发之初预想到，我觉得做自己喜欢的东西会更有感觉一些。”
我们很难在现在就定论《王者万象棋》是否会取得最终成功，但从目前来看，它显然已经有了一个不错的开局。而且，我也很喜欢《王者万象棋》背后这个有点曲折的故事，和Donny反复强调、追逐的那种“感觉”，以及他的几次选择。某种程度上，可能也正是因为这些过程和“感觉”，才构成了我们现在看到的《王者万象棋》崭新的面貌。
html:
9月10日，《王者万象棋》正式开服，上线首日稳居免费榜第1、畅销榜第9，次日升至畅销榜第5。

《王者万象棋》无疑是一款各方面给人的感觉都很“新”的游戏。这种“新”既直观地体现在玩法上，还体现在它各方面传达出的气质，比如游戏架构上简洁优美，美术资产潮酷，商业化比较克制。你很容易可以推断，它的制作团队大概率也是一支很有活力，也十分大胆的团队。

与此同时，作为“王者荣耀”IP产品之一，《王者万象棋》也有很多值得玩味的地方：它的制作人Donny是《王者荣耀》最早的策划之一；它看起来脱胎于《王者荣耀》在2019年上线、一度受到不少玩家好评的“王者模拟战”，但最后的呈现却和传统自走棋玩法天差地别。

后来我了解到，《王者万象棋》的团队规模并不大。与此同时，在整个腾讯产品的大背景中，《王者万象棋》的诞生历程也相当特殊：如果仅从项目本身的研发来说，从确立玩法到测试上线，它的进度其实相当之快，只用了2年；但在这之前，从“要做一个王者IP的策略对战游戏”的闪念，到付诸行动的好几个尝试与弯路，制作人Donny花了整整7年。

就在前段时间，触乐和Donny进行了一次采访。采访的开头，我们询问《王者万象棋》的研发历程，Donny的第一反应是笑着看向身边的同事：“这个可真的是很长的故事了。我昨天晚上刚跟他讲了一遍，但没讲完，讲了好久才讲到2024年。”

在此前的另一次线下采访中，Donny也保持了相同的状态，他放松、健谈，讲起自己的想法很容易滔滔不绝。而且，因为曾经参与《王者荣耀》的策划工作，和Donny的交流话题总会在一些时候折返回到与《王者荣耀》有关的回忆——有意思的地方在于，这些回忆在很多时候也能和《王者万象棋》的诞生形成对照。

Donny告诉触乐，《王者万象棋》的诞生是一个曲折但也幸运的故事。在他看来，这种曲折可能也是游戏研发的常态，但幸运之处在于，他有足够多的想法和支持自己的领导、同事，也一直在做“自己真正想做的东西”。

■ 01

Donny已经有相当长一段时间没有接受正式的对外采访。

他上次有印象的采访还在2018年前后：《王者荣耀》刚刚上线大约两年，但已经“取得了大家都没想到的一些成绩”，一些媒体在那段时间来到天美总部，采访当时的主创团队。彼时Donny的对外身份是“《王者荣耀》助理制作人”，也是在微博上积极和玩家交流的策划。当时，他在采访中分享的话题大多关于《王者荣耀》的诞生过程、对用户的理解以及对游戏的热爱。

也是在那段时间，“想要做一个王者IP的新游戏”的想法产生了，最开始只是一个模糊的、被提报给领导的新项目。新项目的具体构思和来源相当感性：主要因为Donny自己的爱好，他喜欢《昆特牌》《游戏王》等策略游戏，所以下意识地也想做一款“王者”IP的策略游戏。

他开始把目光投向了自走棋品类。当时自走棋品类刚刚起步，Donny第一时间产生了兴趣，立刻在《王者荣耀》团队里拉了一些同事，想做一款“王者”的自走棋——也就是后来的“王者模拟战”。

“我当时觉得做自走棋非常‘有感觉’。”Donny说，这种感觉不仅来自于“做一款新游戏”的成就感，还来自于另一种在他看来相当重要的意义和价值。

“我想，之前我们做游戏一直是跟在外国人后面走，因为他们的游戏行业发展比我们要早几十年。我们是一直属于一个追赶者，很多游戏在积淀上就差了一些。”Donny说，“但自走棋不是这样的。当时，不管是拳头还是V社、暴雪，还是我们——都在相同的起步阶段，我们终于可以和国内外厂商在同一起跑线上面，做同一个品类，公平比拼，看看谁做的产品能成。我觉得这个太有感觉了。”

■ 02

虽然有了这些“很有感觉”的想法，也一度有些“热血沸腾”过。但实际上，在自走棋竞争最白热化的那两年，Donny幻想中的“同台竞争”并没有完全实现。

其中的主要原因或许在于“王者模拟战”的定位，这个模式虽然确实取得了不错的玩家数据，但依然属于《王者荣耀》的内置玩法，并没有清晰独立的发展方式和途径。因此，Donny在这之后不久，开始投入了另一个“王者”IP项目。这是一个完全独立的项目，Donny作为项目制作人。新项目的玩法和卡牌品类有些关联，但研发过程不太顺利。

“在项目做了大概一年的时候，我们已经做出来了一些东西，但是在我看来不够好玩。”他说，“我做得很纠结，左右脑一直在打架。然后，我做了个有点‘自作主张’的决定。”

这个决定指的是，将新项目的方向完全转变。Donny把所有团队成员都拉到一起，大家一起畅聊，反复沟通了很久。他对同事们讲了改变原本的项目方向可能会有哪些风险，也可能有哪些收益，还讲了自己为什么想要“follow my heart”。

“我觉得可能确实会有很多风险和不稳定性。”Donny对我说，“但是当时我想，我还是想要做自己喜欢的、好玩的游戏。”

这次项目内部会的最终结果是，大家一起决定：要做全新的方向，花3个月搓一个新Demo，然后去找老板做汇报。

■ 03

可以先说一个好的结果：那个全新的Demo并没有遭到老板的批评，反而获得了一些“既然想做那就去做吧”的支持。这给了Donny很大的鼓励。

但这款Demo也并不是我们现在看到的《王者万象棋》。因为在这次之后，他们又走了不少弯路。

在对外公开的视角里，《王者万象棋》的首次曝光时间是2022年的“王者荣耀”共创之夜。2022年4月，《王者万象棋》开启了第一次内测，随后以每3个月一次测试的频率进行了为期一年的测试。但到2023年4月，Donny发现了新的问题。

《王者万象棋》吸取了很多来自“王者模拟战”的经验，虽有一些创新，但整体还是没有跳出传统自走棋框架，很多玩法问题显露出来。这让Donny意识到，他们想要去面对市场，似乎必须要再做一次大改，“摸索出一条没有人尝试过的道路”。

“那时候是我压力特别大的时候。”Donny说，“……我很担心同事们没有信心和我再尝试一次。”

但Donny还是下定了决心。他形容这有点像在玩棋牌竞技，“只有翻牌到最后，你才会知道自己手里的牌是多大。但很多时候我们在前面就弃牌了，因为对方的数太大了，你不敢跟。但是我想要把这个牌翻出来，我想要知道结果到底是怎么样的。”

“如果选择了放弃，那就没有任何结果，时间也被浪费了。别人不知道你在做些什么，你做的东西没有面向用户，我觉得是一件很难接受的事情。”

■ 04

2018年，Donny想要做一款“王者”IP的策略卡牌游戏；2019年，他做了“王者模拟战”；后来他尝试过新的项目，再后来启动了《王者万象棋》。现在，他又要做一个和过去完全不同的《王者万象棋》。一个想法天然地出现了：能不能尝试一下，把这些过去的经验、策略卡牌的要素和自走棋做一些结合？

Donny不止一次提到，他非常喜欢策略卡牌游戏。但他也知道，策略卡牌游戏有一个天然的痛点，那就是1v1的对局机制，“输赢都只能怪自己，没有任何可以甩锅的对象，所以很难做出一款大众的游戏”。

“我会想，如果把上面那些玩法要素结合到一起，是不是既能够解决策略卡牌的一些痛点，又能够给策略品类带来新鲜感？”他说，“当时我不知道能不能走通，但我们还是决定试一试。”

后续的尝试确实比之前的几次都更加大胆了。Donny和团队成员们大刀阔斧地改了很多东西，形成了一个初步的“打牌+自走棋”的方案：卡牌被发到玩家手上，玩家拿着牌，用打牌的方式来玩自走棋，英雄会自动战斗。

这是全新的《王者万象棋》的第一个版本，和现在公测的版本其实也有很大差别。但是这个版本已经给了Donny一些信心：“我们感觉好像可以跑通，这里面的玩法逻辑能够形成闭环，而且也是比较有乐趣的。”

打磨了一段时间过后，新版本的《王者万象棋》在2024年4月进行了首次测试。测试的活跃度还不错，但很多玩家都不太理解产品为什么要做如此巨大的改动。

“很多玩家问我们，你们明明之前已经做得挺好了，为什么要换方向？”但同时Donny也注意到，有一部分玩家觉得游戏是有新意的，“尤其是有些第一次接触这个玩法的玩家，他们的接受度比我们想象中高很多。”这带给了他和团队很大信心。

“然后我们就在这个基础上，一步步地修改里面的东西。比如从发牌，变成商店；从60级的等级上限，到999级；还有加上拍卖系统，等等。”每三个月，他们更新一个新的版本，拿出去对外测试，然后再后来继续调整、优化，然后再测试、再看数据。2024年测了3次，2025年又测了4次，今年年中又做了一次较大规模的测试。期间，玩家反馈也越来越好。

“从去年年中开始，我们觉得，这个核心玩法已经基本稳住了。而且这是一个完全由我们自己摸索出来的一条路，这让我非常有成就感。”Donny说。

■ 05

确定了新的核心玩法的《王者万象棋》，推进速度相当之快。某种程度上，正是因为那种不断尝试、改变的基底，才让项目成员都变成了“真的喜欢这款游戏的人”，每个人的想法都开始抒发，有了真正的“创作”的感觉。

比如，游戏里的美术表现，测试期间出圈的王者英雄击杀表情包，很多都是主美和成员们自发构想出来的；也有很多小的细节改进来自于玩家的反馈，社区的启发，这些内容都可以随时被拿出来讨论。

再比如被很多玩家津津乐道的游戏演出效果，很多人想不到，在一年之前，演出效果还是这款游戏的短板。“我们觉得刷牌、选天赋都是很有乐趣的玩法，但好像呈现到游戏里有点‘干’。”Donny说，“后面我们开了一个专项，拉着团队一起集思广益，讨论哪些地方可以让用户觉得很爽，哪些表演可以更华丽和炫酷。”

Donny把《王者万象棋》的开发过程分成三个大的阶段，起初是“王者模拟战”，然后是尝试新项目的阶段，最后是从正式确定名字，再到重新开始的阶段。

这些阶段彼此之间的连通性并不紧密，但很珍贵的一点在于，基本在每个阶段，他都在行为、选择和态度上最大限度地保留了一些执拗的追求，“要做自己喜欢的、有乐趣的游戏”，“想要在职业生涯留下一些东西”。

值得一提的是，在采访的过程中，我和Donny也几次聊到《王者荣耀》——实际上，在《王者荣耀》上线前夕，他们其实也做了很多类似的、此前市场上没有产品做过的决策。这些决策都来自一些同样的理念，那就是不管其他产品通用的做法是什么，他们都想先按照自己认可的方向去做。

“这样可能会有一些风险，但也会有新的生机。”Donny说，“我想做真正的喜欢的东西，即使它可能看起来有点小众，有点风险，况且市场趋势的变化很难在开发之初预想到，我觉得做自己喜欢的东西会更有感觉一些。”

我们很难在现在就定论《王者万象棋》是否会取得最终成功，但从目前来看，它显然已经有了一个不错的开局。而且，我也很喜欢《王者万象棋》背后这个有点曲折的故事，和Donny反复强调、追逐的那种“感觉”，以及他的几次选择。某种程度上，可能也正是因为这些过程和“感觉”，才构成了我们现在看到的《王者万象棋》崭新的面貌。

title: BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony: All The Biggest Announcements And Games
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditional opening ceremony full of announcements and reveals for the company's biggest games--and a few surprises!
The biggest of these included the announcement that StarCraft will return in 2030, but this time, Blizzard is switching up genres as the sci-fi game goes from real-time strategy to open-world shooter. Diablo 5 was also announced, and World of Warcraft fans were spoiled with several reveals. In case you missed it, you can catch all the trailers and news below.
Heroes of the Storm
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wks8GLNUHsk&pp=0gcJCf4LAYcqIYzv
Heroes of the Storm is adding a new hero to its roster for the first time in six years, as Xal'atath is coming to the Nexus. You can try her out starting Monday on the PTR.
For The First Time In 6 Years, Blizzard Is Bringing A New Character To Heroes Of The Storm
A Diablo animated series is in development at Netflix
The next announcement was about a Diablo animated series in development. Blizzard president Johanna Faries announced that it's being produced by Netflix.
"Diablo, I promise, is just the beginning," Faries teased. "To our Overwatch community, to our Warcraft community, and who knows, perhaps even some of our other universes."
Diablo Animated Series Coming To Netflix, Other Blizzard Franchises Teased
StarCraft returns in 2030
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TIu2tGCCKQw
Ubisoft veteran Dan Hay was on stage to announce a brand-new StarCraft, which he described as an open-world shooter. The cinematic trailer showed off some gung-ho Dominion recruits training to be the best in the galaxy, but a few hours later, the remains of these fresh-faced soldiers were being scraped out of their warsuits.
StarCraft Is Officially Back, But It’s Taking A Much Different Form
Overwatch
Overwatch director Aaron Keller was next on stage, dressed in an incredible jacket themed around the game. A new animated trailer was shown off, featuring popular characters like former Talon leader Doomfist, Reaper, Widowmaker, and Sombra as they assaulted a prison pulled from the Watchpoint Gibraltar map. The video ended with a tease of the ninth hero joining Overwatch this year, Doctrine.
Doctrine is a stylish techno-vampire
https://youtu.be/gK877kcyMTY
Miranda Moyer and Ben Bell from the Overwatch team described Doctrine as a Support-class hero who wields a scepter in battle. He mixes vampiric and techno powers together, and he can shroud enemies in darkness to hinder them. Doctrine can also use an "infuse" power to transform his next power. Doctrine's Hero Trial will be available for all Overwatch players later today.
Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
Big Overwatch changes are on the horizon
Sombra and Roadhog are getting some big reworks in Overwatch soon. Sombra is being turned into a Support-class hero, and a whole lot of content is planned for Season 5 of the game.
Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
A familiar face is coming to Diablo 4
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=feXuKlwKMTA
Stay a while, and listen to what's next for Diablo! Tiffany Wat and Brent Gibson from the Diablo team announced that everyone's favorite Horadrim scholar, Deckard Cain, will return to Sanctuary soon. You can meet the fan-favorite character in Diablo 4 on September 15, when Season of Hell's Legacy launches.
Hell's Pawn is crossing over to Diablo Immortal
Todd McFarlane's Spawn is coming to Diablo Immortal, which makes my inner '90s kid very happy. Honestly, could you ask for a better crossover character in the free-to-play mobile game?
Diablo 4 lands on Switch 2 in September
And it'll be out on September 15! Switch 2 owners can grab Diablo 4: Age of Hatred Collection when it launches alongside the new Season of Hell's Legacy.
The Amazon is coming to Diablo 4
At long last, you can play as an Amazon in Diablo 4. This new take on the fan-favorite character will wield her signature bow, as well as the new javelin-class weapon. She'll be added to the game in the first half of 2027.
Diablo 4’s Next Class Is What You Expect But Isn’t Coming With A Full Expansion
Diablo 5 launches in 2029
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8HaSFXR7tU
With the Age of Hatred having concluded in Diablo 4, it's time for the next chapter in the series. Diablo 5 is currently scheduled to launch in Spring 2029, and things look bleak . In Diablo 5, the ancient Lord of Terror has returned and has conquered Sanctuary.
"What must you become, when the world has already fallen?" Wat teased for the dark direction of Diablo 5.
Diablo 5 Is Coming In 2029, Will Actually Star Diablo
Hearthstone's next expansion launches in October
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ib5EMar4b1E
What's next for Hearthstone? A new expansion and a new gameplay mechanic while you explore a narrative focused on the brawls between Old Gods that shaped the world of Azeroth. The new Assemble mechanic will allow you to fuse two cards together, and the Hearthstone team says that it's well aware that there'll be some "pretty busted" combinations. A pool of 250 cards can make use of this mechanic, and some of the combinations shown off are wild. You can try it out for yourself when Reign of the Black Empire launches on October 20.
Hearthstone's new hero is panda-ring to the Warcraft crowd
That's right, the Monk class is finally coming to Hearthstone, marking the first new class in four years.
Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
World of Warcraft: Midnight - Eclipse
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yI09FbRmCtc
World of Warcraft's Holly Longdale and Ion Hazzikostas introduced a new chapter in World of Warcraft's Worldsoul Saga, teasing "all gas and no brakes" in the new major content update. Eclipse will set the stage for a showdown with Xal'atath, and the new cinematic trailer showed her on the verge of a serious power-up.
World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BRnlcUqX5t4
While Eclipse is the next big narrative chapter in World of Warcraft, The Last Titan is where Blizzard is promising a big shake-up to the MMORPG as it wraps up 20 years of storytelling. More details on it will be shared next year.
WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GUobjOJgSqc
Longdale teased that Blizzard is "putting the war back in Warcraft" with the new campaign, Forsaken Kingdom, for Warcraft 3: Reforged. When can you play it? Today! BlizzCon is a big deal if you're a fan of all things Blizzard, and the weekend event kicked off with a traditional opening ceremony full of announcements and reveals for the company's biggest games--and a few surprises!

The biggest of these included the announcement that StarCraft will return in 2030, but this time, Blizzard is switching up genres as the sci-fi game goes from real-time strategy to open-world shooter. Diablo 5 was also announced, and World of Warcraft fans were spoiled with several reveals. In case you missed it, you can catch all the trailers and news below.

Heroes of the Storm

Diablo Animated Series Coming To Netflix, Other Blizzard Franchises Teased

StarCraft returns in 2030

Overwatch director Aaron Keller was next on stage, dressed in an incredible jacket themed around the game. title: For The First Time In 6 Years, Blizzard Is Bringing A New Character To Heroes Of The Storm
author: Chris Pereira
text:
Heroes of the Storm, Blizzard's MOBA mashup of its various franchises, has largely remained unchanged since its developers moved onto other priorities back in 2022. But as WoW's long-running storylines are moving toward a conclusion that involves Xal'atath, that character is set to be added to HotS, and she arrives quite soon.
Blizzard revealed the new addition as part of the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony . Xal'atath will join the Public Test Realm beginning this Monday, September 14, with a full release set for September 28. This will mark the first new character since Warcraft's Hogger was added in 2020.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wks8GLNUHsk
Xal'atath is a ranged assassin whose trait is Void Volley. Soul Essence is built up by basic attacking, and once the meter is full, it can be used to launch void bolts at nearby targets while continuing to move. Other abilities include one that lets Xal'atath blink three times in a triangular pattern, dealing damage and being cancelable to let you reposition.
Here's the full list of Xal'atath's kit:
Trait — Void Volley.  Basic attacks build Soul Essence; at full Essence, unleash a barrage of void bolts at a target area while moving freely. Tied to the Void Whispers quest, which rewards range, faster charge, and piercing, empowered void damage as it progresses.
Q — Dark Heart Ritual.  Summon the Dark Heart talisman to pulse void energy at nearby enemies, then follow and detonate on any Shadow-Marked hero.
W — Void Step.  Blink between three points in a triangular pattern, gaining attack damage at each stop; can be cancelled early to reposition or escape.
E — Shadow Mark.  Cast a large Void Orb that marks heroes hit by its inner radius; the Dark Heart moves to the impact point and detonates on marked heroes.
Heroic — Void Eruption.  Channel a growing void orb, launch it to blind enemies and dominate space, then detonate in a large area — cast on the Dark Heart for an instant, fully empowered eruption.
Heroic — Void Convergence.  Summon a portal that spawns relentless void minions to overwhelm nearby enemies, replacing fallen minions until the portal ends or is destroyed.
While Xal'atath might turn out to be a one-off addition to the game, it was teased that another character could be added in the future. Given balance updates and a skin have represented the bulk of what's changed since Hogger's launch, it's welcome to see anything of substance arrive for HotS.

title: StarCraft Is Officially Back, But It’s Taking A Much Different Form
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Following numerous rumors dating back many months, it's official: StarCraft is returning with a new game, but that game won't be in the traditional real-time-strategy genre the franchise is known for. Instead, the new StarCraft game is described as an open-world shooter.
The news was revealed as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony . However, that's essentially all we know, as the new game-referred to only as StarCraft--won't be released until 2030. As such, there were no further details shared about how it will play or anything else.
After Blizzard's Dan Hay said, "It's about damn time" that we returned to the interstellar war of StarCraft, we did see a cinematic trailer. Dominion forces are shown being pumped up after being trained as elite warriors. They're then sent onto the battlefield against a massive wave of Zerg forces.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TIu2tGCCKQw
When it does arrive, this will mark the first original game in the StarCraft franchise since the StarCraft II trilogy wrapped up with Legacy of the Void in 2015. The original game did receive a remaster, StarCraft Remastered, in 2017, but Blizzard's focus has otherwise shifted to its other franchises over the last decade.
While a StarCraft shooter had been rumored for some time, the reveal is still sure to come as a contentious piece of news for fans starved for a traditional StarCraft game. (The audible reaction from the crowd when "open-world shooter" was said was not necessarily one of elation.)
This isn't the first attempt to spin off the series into something else, as StarCraft Ghost was meant to be a stealth-action entry, but it was ultimately canceled prior to release. A recent report indicated that Nexon is seeking the StarCraft license in order to make a new game--possibly StarCraft III--so there may still be some hope for another StarCraft RTS.
Teases for a StarCraft revival began earlier this month, after the game's official website started to "glitch" and fans discovered hidden text logs. Each one appeared to be a secret transmission hinting at something on the horizon, with rumors circulating that it could be anything from a Helldivers-inspired co-op shooter game to the revival of StarCraft: Ghost.
But the main takeaway is that StarCraft is back, and in a big way. While it wasn't the first successful franchise to emerge from Blizzard, it still remains a key pillar for the company even after years of dormancy. The original StarCraft real-time strategy game and its Brood War expansion were huge hits upon release, and in South Korea, local internet cafes became hubs for competitive PvP that laid the groundwork for the rise of esports.

title: Overwatch’s Newest Blood-Sucking Character Pushes The Game Even Further Into The Fantasy Genre
author: Jessica Cogswell
text:
Since its inception, Overwatch has positioned itself as an optimistic, science-fiction-driven world. Although some characters have introduced an element of the fantastical--the addition of the magical Wuxing University being the most notable tonal shift--the team behind the hero shooter has always prioritized scientific explanations for its heroes incredible abilities. Its newest character, however, seems to venture further into fantasy than ever before.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gK877kcyMTY
Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , Doctrine is the next support hero coming to Overwatch. Oh and fun fact, he's a vampire--or vampire-inspired, at the very least. With a sceptre that heals and speeds up teammates yet dishes out major damage to enemies, Doctrine is an extremely powerful hero with a high mechanical floor. Interested in putting your skills to the test and giving him a whirl? You're in luck, as Doctrine's limited-time hero trial has officially kicked off and will run until September 14.
In addition to his sceptre, Doctrine can also unleash a swarm of bat drones, infuse allies, and "manipulate life force." Blizzard has described the hero as the "ultimate vampire fantasy." Below is a more thorough look at his Hero kit:
While Doctrine (real name Tamuka Yeukai) hails from Zimbabwe, he is accompanied by the Escort map Watchpoint: Grimsvotn, which depicts the Icelandic prison he is seen escaping in his debut cinematic. Doctrine joins Overwatch on the side of Talon, his trailer revealing him to be a close friend of Doomfist. This relationship also expresses itself mechanically, as the Overwatch team stated his kit complements Doomfist's extremely well.
In other Overwatch news, the team shared that two of its most criticized legacy characters, Sombra and Roadhog, are undergoing major changes .

title: Overwatch Is Reworking Two Of Its Most Criticized Characters
author: Jessica Cogswell
text:
After years of complaints, Overwatch is finally reworking two of its veteran heroes. Announced during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , both Roadhog and Sombra will be receiving major reworks, with Sombra pivoting to being a support hero and Roadhog undergoing changes to make him more of a team player.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LBt8q49qD8k
Shortly after the reveal, Overwatch shared an updated look at both character's Hero kits. Below is a comprehensive overview of their changes:
Sombra
Of the two, Sombra is receiving the most significant redesign, pivoting from a Damage hero to Support. Whereas she used to be most effective at fast-paced, ambush-style combat, she will now be far more useful in team settings. Her Hack ability has been replaced with Hotfix, which allows her to freely hack health packs and enemy deployables as well as heal allies. Cyberspace replaces Virus, and sees Sombra launch a projectile that heals allies and weakens enemies. With the exception of CTRL ALT ESC, all of Sombra's Perks have been adjusted, and she now boasts Support passives.
Roadhog
By comparison Roadhog's changes are far less dramatic, with the most notable being the removal of Scrap Gun's Alt Fire. In lieu of this skill, Roadhog has been given Trash Compactor--an ability that allows Roadhog to absorb enemy projectiles and turn them into an explosive ball of scrap. This makes him far more effective as an actual Tank, granting him what seems like a fairly effective barrier that will hopefully deter players from abandoning their team in search of smaller firefights.
In addition to these changes, Blizzard has announced Overwatch's 54th character, Doctrine , is coming October 5.

title: Diablo 4’s Next Class Is What You Expect But Isn’t Coming With A Full Expansion
author: Darryn Bonthuys
text:
Diablo 4's next class is Amazon, Blizzard announced during the BlizzCon opening ceremony , but it won't be coming as part of a new expansion. Instead, Blizzard will sell the Amazon as a separate DLC class pack in the first half of next year.
The addition of the Amazon isn't exactly a surprise. First, it's an iconic class from Diablo 2, so it's a bit of a no-brainer there. Alongside the nostalgia factor, Diablo 4's latest expansion, Lord of Hatred, also took players to the literal home of the Amazons, Skovos. They featured heavily in the expansion's story but were not a playable class, with the expansion instead adding the Paladin and Warlock to Diablo 4's class roster.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=feXuKlwKMTA
While the Amazon isn't coming until 2027, Diablo 4's next season, Hell's Legacy, is coming much sooner. The season kicks off next week on September 15 and will celebrate the franchise's 30th anniversary and feature the return of enemies, locations, and items from previous Diablo games. That will include the return of Deckard Cain, who will take players on a journey to confront Diablo, Baal, and Mephisto, meaning the Lord of Terror himself will finally make an appearance in Diablo 4.
Though it leaked ahead of time, Diablo 4 is officially coming to the Switch 2 as well, with a Lord of Hatred collection that includes both of the game's expansions.

title: Diablo 5 Is Coming In 2029, Will Actually Star Diablo
author: Cameron Koch
text:
Diablo 5 is coming in Spring 2029, and it will take players to a world where Diablo himself reigns supreme.
Announced via a short teaser during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , Blizzard revealed it's already at work on the next installment of the series. Set 100 years after the defeat of Mephisto in Diablo 4: Lord of Hatred, Diablo 5 will see the Lord of Terror return. However, instead of stopping him from destroying all of Sanctuary, he will actually have already won.
Blizzard teased Diablo 5's story will revolve around what heroes have to become in a post-apocalyptic world that is already destroyed. More details will be shared about the game's lore, classes, and gameplay features, during a Diablo 5 panel as part of this weekend's convention.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8HaSFXR7tU
Should Diablo 5 actually release in 2029, it will be the shortest gap between Diablo games in the franchise's history. There was a 12-year wait for Diablo 3 after Diablo 2, and another 11 years between Diablo 3 and 4. Diablo 5, in comparison, is slated to come just six years after Diablo 4--still a long time, but much shorter given the franchise's track record.
Blizzard has been on record saying it wants to create new Diablo games faster . In an interview earlier this year, Blizzard said that "over the next 30 years, maybe we get some out faster."

Diablo 5, in comparison, is slated to come just six years after Diablo 4--still a long time, but much shorter given the franchise's track record.

Blizzard has been on record saying it wants to create new Diablo games faster. In an interview earlier this year, Blizzard said that "over the next 30 years, maybe we get some out faster."

title: Hearthstone’s First New Class In 4 Years And A More Story-Driven Journal Are On The Way
author: Chris Pereira
text:
New class additions to Hearthstone don't come often, but the next one has been announced during BlizzCon 2026's Opening Ceremony : The Monk is coming to the card game, leaving just the Evoker as the lone class to be left out.
The Monk's upcoming addition was one of several major pieces of news for Hearthstone revealed. A new expansion called Reign of the Black Empire that is set 10,000 years in the past will focus on the Black Empire and a struggle between the Old Gods and the Titans.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ib5EMar4b1E
If that excites the lore enjoyer in you, you'll also be happy to hear that the Journal is being transformed into The Journey. This is meant to give a more narrative-driven wrapper to the game, as it'll seek to tie the story together between expansions, modes, and limited-time events. The Journey will grow as you play through Reign of the Black Empire, tying together quests, achievements, and more elements of the game.
As far as the Monk goes, we don't know much in terms of how they'll play. We only got a short teaser for the new class, which marks the first such addition since the Death Knight arrived in 2022. The game originally launched with nine characters before later adding Demon Hunter and then Death Knight. The Monk will arrive in March 2027, with more details coming next year.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hldzvHmT-ow
Other new features coming to Hearthstone include a new keyword, Assemble, which lets you effectively merge two minions into one, which sounds similar to Magnetize; you can pick specific text from their descriptions to create new combos. A new minion type, Aberrations, was also revealed, with their deaths feeding the gods in some way. Aberrations will be specific to Battlegrounds, which is also getting a 2v2 main ranked mode.
Reign of the Black Empire releases on October 20.

title: WoW: The Last Titan Cinematic Ups The Stakes, But First, Xal’atath
author: Cameron Koch
text:
As is BlizzCon tradition, a new World of Warcraft cinematic premiered during the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony , setting the stage for the MMORPG's next expansion, The Last Titan.
In a departure for BlizzCon, that glimpse was just about all fans learned about the new expansion, with Blizzard instead looking to put the focus more on the final content patch of the game's current Midnight expansion.
That update, titled Eclipse, will consist of a climactic showdown with the franchise's current main villain, Xal'atath. An in-game cinematic shown during the ceremony revealed Xal'atath's true objective, to merge with Azeroth's worldsoul and become unstoppable.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yI09FbRmCtc
Blizzard additionally teased a new standalone game mode, and yet another expansion Remix experience, will also be coming to Midnight before the expansion's end.
As for The Last Titan's setting, it takes players back to Northrend, the continent previously seen in 2008's Wrath of the Lich King expansion. Much like how Blizzard revamped Silvermoon City and the Blood Elf lands of Quel'thalas in Midnight to great results, Northrend will be completely rebuilt from the ground up. Blizzard said more details about The Last Titan will be shared next year.
The Last Titan was first announced at BlizzCon 2023, when Blizzard made the unprecedented move of announcing an entire trilogy of expansions all at once. Collectively, Blizzard called the three expansions The Worldsoul Saga, with a goal of bringing together many of WoW's disparate storylines from over the last 20 years into one fitting conclusion.
As the end of the trilogy, The Last Titan has a lot of expectations to live up to that the main storyline of WoW's two previous expansions, The War Within and Midnight, haven't exactly met. Regardless, it will still be exciting to see how Blizzard ties two decades' worth of story involving the Void, the Titans, and Azeroth herself together into one cohesive package.

title: Warcraft Getting Its First New RTS Campaign In Two Decades–And It’s Playable Today
author: Cameron Koch
text:
A new Warcraft 3 campaign exploring the origins of the Forsaken and the formation of the Undercity will be live later today, Blizzard announced as part of its BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony announcements .
Titled Forsaken Kingdom, the DLC campaign will put a spotlight on the last days of Lordaeron after it fell to Arthas and how it became the home of the Forsaken many players are familiar with in World of Warcraft. The campaign will be available in Warcraft 3: Reforged, Blizzard's once-maligned remaster of 2003's RTS classic. While the new campaign costs money, the 3.0 update for Warcraft 3: Reforged is free and also releases today. The update adds new visual improvements and quality-of-life features.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I1kXClUCyuA
This is just the latest update to Warcraft 3: Reforged that looks to salvage its poor reputation. In 2024, Blizzard released a 2.0 update as part of the franchise's 30th anniversary that sought to address many of the common complaints players have had with the remaster since its 2020 launch. Reports from the time indicated Warcraft 3: Reforged was the victim of budget cuts and rocky development, and even saw Blizzard expand its refund policy in the wake of its release.
Forsaken Kingdom will be the first new Warcraft RTS content since the release of the original Warcraft 3's Frozen Throne expansion in 2003. Earlier this year, Blizzard made it so players could access the classic version of Warcraft 3 through Battle.net without the need to also launch Warcraft 3: Reforged.

title: WoW Forever Will Add All-New Content To Classic Azeroth This November
author: Cameron Koch
text:
World of Warcraft Forever is Blizzard's next iteration on WoW Classic, one that will add new content in the form of zones, quests, dungeons, raids, and even a new playable race while keeping the old-school MMORPG's world and gameplay intact.
Revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , WoW Forever is Blizzard's attempt to give WoW Classic fans the "forever" game they've wanted for years. However, instead of the MMO progressing to the game's subsequent expansions and their new areas, as Classic has in the past, WoW Forever will instead keep the focus on WoW's original two continents, Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
Within that Classic backdrop will be up to 1,000 new quests, Blizzard said, as well as revamped zones, and three entirely new zones that fill out areas present on the map in vanilla WoW but were never accessible to players. There will be nine new dungeons to explore, two raids, and an additional PvP battleground. A new playable race is also part of the package: the Skyborne elves. One of the new playable zones will be their starting area, Blizzard said.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEMrosrAVH0
In addition to all-new content, Blizzard will be revamping classes with new talents and skills, as well as allowing for new class and race combinations. An option to toggle HD visuals and old-school graphics will also be included. Blizzard will continue to update WoW Forever with new content, but won't raise the level cap past 60.
Unlike modern WoW, WoW Forever won't be focused on the endgame experience. Blizzard said many of the new dungeons and quests will be for characters under level 60. That aligns with what Blizzard said were its core principles in how it approached development of WoW Forever--that it should be about the journey, not the destination; the world itself is a character; and the game's social aspects should be a focus.
For those who want to continue experiencing the original version of Azeroth, the normal version of WoW Classic will still be playable.
Players won't have to wait long to experience this new version of Azeroth themselves. A playable beta will go live September 17, with the full version of WoW Forever launching November 4.

title: Diablo 5’s Revealed Classes Are Throwbacks To Diablo 3, With One Exception
author: Cameron Koch
text:
Diablo 5 isn't coming until Spring 2029 , but Blizzard has already revealed three of the game's playable classes.
Two of them will be familiar to Diablo 3 fans: the Monk and Demon Hunter. The third will be an all-new class, the Plague Knight. The Plague Knight sounds similar to Death Knights from Blizzard's other fantasy franchise and are described as "walking death" that spread disease and pestilence wherever they go, then consume it to increase their power.
Blizzard revealed plenty of new details about Diablo 5 during a panel and subsequent blog post following the game's cinematic reveal as part of the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony . In addition to the three classes, Blizzard outlined the state of Sanctuary in Diablo 5 and how players will navigate it. Rather than journeying to towns, players will instead build a wandering caravan of survivors in a world that's been destroyed, and currently ruled, by Diablo himself. According to a developer blog post, Diablo 5's world will be "procedural," where terrain, monsters, and points of interest will change in the wake of the Lord of Terror's influence.
As for the survivors that players will call allies, Blizzard said they will serve roles as vendors and companions. Two examples of companions that will accompany players are a former Sister of the Sightless Eye and a lost treasure goblin searching for meaning "in a world where greed has lost its meaning," Blizzard said.
Though Diablo 5 is still early in development, there was some information about how it will play compared to Diablo 4. An early look at the game's inventory screen and items is extremely reminiscent of Diablo 2. Blizzard said it's a goal for items in Diablo 5 to be "readable, memorable, and worth chasing across hundreds of hours." Like in Diablo 2, items will take up more space in one's inventory depending on their size. Blizzard also confirmed item sets will return, as will Diablo 2-style runes and runewords.
Blizzard may be putting the focus on Diablo 5, but there is still new content coming for Diablo 4. A new class, t he Amazon , will be sold as a standalone DLC pack in the first half of next year, and the game will continue to receive new seasonal content. Diablo 4 Season 15, Hell's Legacy, goes live on September 15 and will see the return of Deckard Cain. The iconic Horadrim will task players with confronting remnants of the Prime Evils, including Diablo himself.

title: Diablo 4’s Expansion Days Are Over
author: Cameron Koch
text:
Diablo 4 won't receive more expansions moving forward, as Blizzard shifts its focus to the newly revealed Diablo 5 instead.
As revealed during BlizzCon 2026's opening ceremony , Diablo 5 is slated to be coming in Spring 2029 and is set 100 years after Diablo 4 in a world where the titular Lord of Terror reigns supreme. In an interview with PC Gamer , Diablo game director Brent Gibson said there were no plans for additional Diablo 4 expansions, as the team is instead "focused on seasons [for Diablo 4] and getting to Diablo 5." He added that Blizzard told the "story of Hatred" culminating in the Lord of Hatred expansion, and now it's moving forward to tell the "story of Terror."
That doesn't mean support for Diablo 4 will end anytime soon. It sounds like Diablo 4's seasons will lead into the events of Diablo 5, even though the latter takes place a century later. That gives Blizzard room to set up Diablo 5's story, though Gibson said Blizzard doesn't "have a perfect picture" where it will all go because it wants to see how fans "react season to season."
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-FfJppNJsNY
Diablo 4 is the only Diablo game to have received more than one expansion. Prior to release, Blizzard said it would receive "annual" expansions , though that quickly didn't come to pass. The game's Lord of Hatred expansion was released in April of this year, around a year-and-a-half after Diablo 4's first expansion, Vessel of Hatred.
It's not a new expansion, but Diablo 4 is receiving a new class. The Amazon will join Diablo 4 as a standalone DLC next year. Diablo 4 Season 15, Hell's Legacy, begins September 15, and will see the return of iconic locations, items, Deckard Cain. The iconic Hordadrim will task players with battling memories of the Prime Evils from previous Diablo games, including Diablo himself.

title: 《inZOI》最新试玩+访谈：追求更深的模拟维度｜IGN 中国
author: Kamui Ye
text:
上线 EA 一年多的《inZOI（云族裔）》随着版本不断迭代，游戏体验和口碑逐渐趋于稳定，不少玩家都对游戏基于 UE5 引擎打造的细致画面表示高度认可，这带来了更细致和真实的环境氛围、建模还有角色表情，让整个模拟空间更具可信度。
另一方面，由 KRAFTON 和英伟达合作研发的 Smart Zoi AI 系统也因为玩家数据的逐步积累而日趋完善，在符合条件的硬件支持下，当前版本的 NPC 应付玩家基于自然语言的对话已经基本不存在问题。
2026 TAPTAP 玩聚节会场入口
Taptap 玩聚节《Inzoi》展台
2026 年 9 月 12 日~13 日在上海举行的 TapTap 玩聚节活动期间，我们体验了《inZOI》全新功能“画布小镇”的专属试玩版本，该系统可以看做是一个游戏内的 UGC 平台，玩家既可以保存自己的各种经历，也能自由组合游戏自带的素材搭建自定义脚本和关卡，在这些脚本中可以扮演任何角色。
该 DEMO 包含十几个特定脚本环境下的自制关卡，可以充分感受到自定义角色与环境、NPC 丰富的互动层次感，多样化的互动方式还有自由的角色设定与脚本相互配合，极大拓展了《inZOI》给人的固有玩法印象。
各种脚本快捷带入新角色
试玩版准备好的脚本既有类似《糖豆人：终极淘汰赛》的跳跃闯关玩法，也有基于现成的城市建模素材打造的 Mini 赛车，让人更具沉浸感和更能体验游戏特色的，还要数各种角色扮演脚本。
通过“画布小镇”终端访问这些关卡
在一个“帮助失忆女友恢复记忆”的脚本中，按照原本的游戏发展安排，男主角原本要给我做拌饭作为午餐，我尝试与其进行了自然语言对话，比如说“给我下碗面”之类的，对方会回答家里没有相关食材，现在只能做拌饭之类的，以相对符合逻辑的语言来应对无法满足要求，而不是像传统模拟游戏那样基本上把玩家的选择固定在特定的几个选择之中。
可以用自然语言跟 NPC 对话
当然，Smart Zoi 系统由于本地部署的语言模型参数无法跟市面上正经的 AI 大模型相提并论，所以多问几句还是很容易陷入循环，想要推进故事基本上还是得跟着脚本的安排走，去完成一个又一个的指定任务，但相对于以往已经是相当大的体验进步。
上面这种基于“恋人关系”打造的脚本还算给了 AI 系统较大的发挥空间，另一个“便利店打工”的脚本则可以看做是“画布小镇”任务制系统的演示，主角的基本活动范围停留在一家便利店内，任务列表活像一部“便利店打工日志”，有打扫门店、清理桌子、整理物品等等，当然你也可以跟来来往往的 AI 顾客进行互动，观察他们的喜怒哀乐。
甚至有一个赛车游戏，当然内容比较简单
试玩 DEMO 里的各种脚本均来自官方和玩家制作，客观来讲一定程度上展示了“画布小镇”功能的内容深度，给玩家留下很大的想象空间。除此之外，AI 系统的另一大特色便是成长性，随着积累的数据越来越丰富，在可预见的将来有很大可能性可以为玩家提供更完善的生活体验。
《inZOI》制作人金亨俊、助理李承珉访谈
活动当天我们还有幸采访到《inZOI》的制作人金亨俊以及助理李承珉先生。金制作人在 TapTap 玩聚节活动现场进行了舞台分享以及线下签名等活动，听取了来自玩家的直接反馈，其中一些让他十分感慨。
以下是此次访谈的主要内容。
本作制作人金亨俊
—— 看到您在官网上有公布一个更新 Roadmap，从中可以发现这款游戏在过去一年经历了较大规模的系统重做，能否介绍一下这次现场提供的试玩 DEMO 想要展示的迭代重点是什么？
金亨俊： 重点一共有两个。
第一是多人联机（Multiplay）相关内容。作为人生模拟类游戏，观察他人的生活是非常重要的。第二，之前我们在线上跟用户交流时发现，现在AI技术发展飞快，我们可以把它加入到生活中，让角色们能够生活在一起，产生链接。以上两点是本次现场版本中，想要跟大家重点表现的内容。
—— 制作人在之前的分享中提到这个版本“表面上看东西不多，但底下在翻地基”。如果用一个玩家进游戏马上能感觉到的变化来解释“这版值不值得更新”，可否举一个例子来说明？
金亨俊： 我个人还是希望从联机功能这个角度给大家做推荐，这样大家会觉得更新的这版是值得的。因为基于 AI 系统制作的 NPC、以及一些主要内容的更新，还有我们今天在现场给大家体验到的一些内容，其实到最终正式上市还需要一点时间，所以联机这部分其实是我最推荐的。
另外我还想重点推荐一个内容。因为人生是平凡的，但我们平凡的人生中还是会有一些发光的瞬间，因此我们上线了“画布小镇”这个功能，也是希望大家在玩人生模拟类游戏的时候可以把自己重要的瞬间记录下来。举一个例子，比如有人向我告白，我可以通过“画布小镇”把这样的瞬间记录下来变成独立的脚本关卡。
—— 想请问一下，抢先体验版（EA）上线已经一年多，现在回头看，您觉得当初选择抢先体验模式的决定是否正确？假如说可以晚点上线，把这个产品打磨得再好一点，局面会不会更好？
金亨俊： 这个问题我非常熟悉，这是一个非常好的问题。因为我在不同的国家接受采访时，都会有记者朋友提出这个问题，而我的答案是并不后悔。
这个游戏带给了我非常大的惊喜，惊喜点在于它做起来真的很难。我有 30 年的游戏从业经历，但这么难做的游戏也是首次遇到。今天在签名会的现场，有很多用户向我反馈说“还是蛮好的”，这让我十分欣慰。所以到目前为止，我并没有后悔过上线抢先体验版本这件事，我觉得这个版本在合适的时间上线与大家见面了。
而且今天在现场签名会的时候，有一位玩了我们抢先版比较深入的朋友，提出了一个非常细节的问题，说某个画面有一道白线非常影响沉浸式体验，问我们能不能改一下。这就说明，抢先上线虽然不完美，但它完成了，并且得到了反馈。包括在用户层面，大家也是能够理解和接受这个事情的，这真的非常重要，我们可以跟玩家们一起把它创造得越来越好。
—— 刚刚上线不久的 9 月 3 号的更新，你们不堆新内容，专门把 Zoi“半夜不睡觉、乱坐椅子、有车不会自己开”等等这种日常搞笑的行为修正了一遍。你们自己内部测试的时候，大家更喜欢哪个？觉得哪个更好笑？
金亨俊： 这种行为在游戏里称之为自由行动类。其实解决这个问题比较难，我们团队内部用了非常大的心血去解决。为了游戏的稳定性，如果让 Zoi 的行动太过于完美，会让它们看起来非常机械、无聊；如果让它们看起来像傻瓜一样自由行动，又会让它们看起来像个“小傻子”。
我们整体团队的意见是，让它控制在一定的比例以内，既不会那么机械无聊，但同时又不会让它像个傻子一样，保持一点“活人感”，让大家觉得游戏更有活力。
—— 加深“生活模拟的深度”一直是制作组的目标，不过这个概念本身比较抽象，能否请制作人进一步阐释一下到底什么是“加深生活模拟的深度”？
金亨俊： 我也承认，“加深生活模拟的深度”是比较抽象的概念。因为相对于其他游戏，比如对战类的最后要剩下一个人，或者是有明确的关卡必须活下去等等，我们的内容确实有点抽象。
在游戏发售初期我其实是有点担心的。就像我今天在现场舞台上跟大家分享的一样，我们这款游戏可以让用户玩家体验一下在现实生活中没有办法做到的事情。比如说现实生活中是比较“I”（内向）的人，但是心里想变“E”（外向）的时候，你可以在游戏世界里变得很“E”，去体验一些你在现实生活中想体验但没有机会体验的东西。
游戏本身带给用户的，就是让你在假想的世界里做到你在现实世界里做不到的事情。用户玩家在假想的游戏世界里获得一种勇气，就相当于是提前为现实生活做的一种实习。
其实很多人都误会我了，觉得我做分享游刃有余，其实不是这样的。刚才站在台上的时候，我觉得我的灵魂已经离开我的身体了（笑）。每次面对记者朋友们的时候我也会非常紧张。当然，我在游戏当中就会游刃有余，这也是游戏给我现实生活中的一种勇气。
—— 能不能透露一下主机版本目前的进展？
金亨俊： 开发基本已经结束了，目前还在做一些优化，争取在明年上半年左右，或者更早一点让它跟大家见面。它应该会和《inZOI》的正式版本差不多同一时间推出，也会成为让大家不会失望的游戏。我们还是想把它的功能做得更加完善一点，所以并没有像 PC 版一样有一个提前的抢先体验版本。
—— 刚才您提到了体验上的变化，有一些 AI NPC 我也在试玩 DEMO 中跟它们进行了一些聊天。除了我们看到的 AI 对话以外，它们还有没有一些我们看不到的作用？尤其是在NPC交互方面？
金亨俊： 关于 AI NPC 这部分其实带给了我非常大的惊喜。因为在游戏当中 Zoi 的很多活动、行动本来是事前已经预设好了的，但 AI 的出现会让它们有点像人一样，会看眼色，自己去计算得失然后再行动。
比如说在我们的内容里，如果出现了两名男士追求一位女士，有一位男士睡着了，另外一个男士自己就会开始算计，想着我的竞争者睡着了，这是我告白的好机会，会见缝插针地表现自己。起初这样的内容带给我的其实是类似惊吓的情绪，但同样也是一种惊喜。
还有一个令我印象深刻的片段是跟 AI 借钱，结果没有一个人借给我，最后还是游戏里的女儿借给我的。这是我们事先没有计划的事情，AI Zoi 做出了意想之外的举动，因为这些行动都是经过计算的，仔细想想好像也符合常理。
—— 刚才您提到了明年正式版的相关问题，想问一下正式版本跟今天的版本会有哪些差异？哪些内容要补完？在您的想象中正式版应该是一个什么样的形态？
金亨俊： 与其说抢先版和正式版中间的绝对差异点，我更希望分享的是，从一年前的抢先版上市以来，我们一直在不断更新的内容。玩家可以游泳、建房子、种地，这些都是不断增加的内容。
计划明年上半年上线的正式版本，相当于我们把所有的更新内容放在了正式的版本里面，包括衣服的选择也会增加到上百套的样子。其实就相当于是从一个不太完美的版本变成了一个完成度非常高的版本，可以这么去理解。我们在玩抢先版的时候能感觉到有些地方让玩家感觉不那么自然，在正式版本中我们也会克服这个问题。
—— 我看到《inZOI》目前版本已经有了对 Mod 的支持，在 EA 阶段就把精力花在 Mod 支持上会不会有点早？制作组是怎么考虑的？这是否能有效提升目前玩家的活跃度？
金亨俊： 在抢先体验版本里面支持 Mod 这个事情让我十分“后悔”（笑）。虽然我刚才说了后悔，因为我的精力要放到两个方向上，这是非常分散精力的事情，而且我也是第一次做支持 Mod 的游戏。
但是通过 Mod 这件事情，也给我们的游戏带来了一些不一样的东西。比如说我们最近收到一个玩家发过来的关于婚纱内容创作，他说正是因为有了 Mod 功能才得以完成，这时候我就会觉得 Mod 还是挺有用的。总结起来一句话：虽然做得后悔，过程也比较艰难，但是感觉效果也还不错。
大家利用 Mod 功能其实也让游戏的可玩性变强了。比如最近有一个打篮球的相关内容，目前在本作的世界里打篮球都只有一些比较简单的动作，但是用 Mod 强化之后，它可以变成一个竞技项目，可以记分什么的，所以我认为 Mod 是可以强化体验的一个东西。
还有，之所以会觉得做完之后效果很好，主要是因为我每个星期都会跟玩家沟通，大家会发给我一些用 Mod 做的内容，总数有时候高达 400 个，如果让我们的制作组来做，那是完全不可能实现的工作量，但现在我们可以跟玩家一起用 Mod 去不断完善《inZOI》，我觉得这是很好的事情。所以，我虽然最开始说了后悔在抢先版上线 Mod，但我作为正式回答，我是不后悔的。
—— 因为刚才回答的时候已经提到了正式版和抢先版的内容差距，想请问一下会不会有一些大家现在不知道，或者意想不到的惊喜内容在正式版上线的时候？
金亨俊： 有惊喜内容。就因为是惊喜内容，所以今天不能回答你（笑）。准确来说有两个惊喜，其中第一个我们刚才在舞台活动中已经向玩家们宣布了，就是会支持养猫的功能，这是其中一个惊喜。因为这个功能也是很多玩家向我们提出的诉求，我们一直以来没有满足大家，所以在正式版本的时候决定满足大家。
另一个则要等待正式版上线的时候才会公布了（笑）。
—— 这次来上海参加 TapTap 玩聚节活动，在线下跟中国内地玩家见面，制作人最想问中国玩家的问题是什么？
金亨俊： 无论是在中国、韩国，所谓东亚国家，好像还是竞技类的游戏占主流。但是我今天在现场看到大家的反响非常好，我也从中获得了勇气和力量。我最想询问大家的其实很简单，就是我们在《inZOI》里面放什么样的内容，大家会喜欢、会感到高兴呢？
这也是我和我的制作组们经常聊的话题，制作组也会问我，我们制作什么样的内容，放什么样的功能玩家会喜欢呢？
我今天在现场有公开联机相关的内容，这其实背后有一个小故事：有一个中国的网红发邮件给我，他说为了中国的玩家，请一定要做联机，所以我决定做联机。
所以大家如果有希望在《inZOI》里看到的东西，请一定要联系我们。
—— 刚才您开场说《inZOI》这个游戏很难做，我们也一直在想，因为生活模拟这个品类确实很难。这么多年，一说生活模拟就是《模拟人生》系列，其他的游戏很难出头。您作为制作这个品类的开发者，肯定也对《模拟人生》系列做了很深入的研究，对于这个品类，您能够从《模拟人生》上学到什么？
金亨俊： 首先，我觉得《模拟人生》系列是非常大胆的游戏，因为它二十年如一日的在进行不断的开发和研究，这一点是非常大胆和厉害的。《模拟人生》的团队也曾到过我们公司，为我们进行了非常好的分享。
而说起想要借鉴的部分，首先《模拟人生》系列幽默、搞笑的特色十分突出，而《inZOI》目前给人的感觉更偏向真实系，一旦游戏走这条路线，玩家就会反馈说玩起来总感觉哪里有点尴尬（笑）。
前段时间《模拟人生》系列有一位开发者在接受访问的时候曾经提到：“《inZOI》幽默不足”，负责采访的那位记者的我也跟他打过交道，看到这句话的时候我感觉真的很有意思。
我在开发《inZOI》之前其实就对《模拟人生》系列的开发团队十分敬佩，做了《inZOI》之后那种敬佩感愈发强烈，因为二十年如一日的不断开发、研究，真的不是一件容易的事情。
—— 这一次来到 TapTap 玩聚节，有没有遇到一些比较好玩的经历或者印象比较深刻的事情？
金亨俊： 首先，最惊讶的是有一位玩家可以全程用韩语跟我交流，他说得太好了，我一度怀疑他是不是也来自韩国。第二个印象深刻的是，有一位玩家指出了某个画面上的问题，并且说让我们赶紧修改，这种单刀直入的表述真的很有意思（笑）。
但最让我感动的是，很多玩家在签名会的时候跟我说：“请你们要一直做下去，要一直更新下去，要一直坚持下去。”这让我非常感动。
我之前觉得《inZOI》这种人生模拟类的游戏，在亚洲来说没有那么大众化。但是今天在 TapTap 玩聚节这个活动上，我得到了很多的反馈和力量，所以我将满怀着感动和惊喜回到韩国去。
html:
上线 EA 一年多的《inZOI（云族裔）》随着版本不断迭代，游戏体验和口碑逐渐趋于稳定，不少玩家都对游戏基于 UE5 引擎打造的细致画面表示高度认可，这带来了更细致和真实的环境氛围、建模还有角色表情，让整个模拟空间更具可信度。

另一方面，由 KRAFTON 和英伟达合作研发的 Smart Zoi AI 系统也因为玩家数据的逐步积累而日趋完善，在符合条件的硬件支持下，当前版本的 NPC 应付玩家基于自然语言的对话已经基本不存在问题。

2026 年 9 月 12 日~13 日在上海举行的 TapTap 玩聚节活动期间，我们体验了《inZOI》全新功能“画布小镇”的专属试玩版本，该系统可以看做是一个游戏内的 UGC 平台，玩家既可以保存自己的各种经历，也能自由组合游戏自带的素材搭建自定义脚本和关卡，在这些脚本中可以扮演任何角色。

该 DEMO 包含十几个特定脚本环境下的自制关卡，可以充分感受到自定义角色与环境、NPC 丰富的互动层次感，多样化的互动方式还有自由的角色设定与脚本相互配合，极大拓展了《inZOI》给人的固有玩法印象。

各种脚本快捷带入新角色

试玩版准备好的脚本既有类似《糖豆人：终极淘汰赛》的跳跃闯关玩法，也有基于现成的城市建模素材打造的 Mini 赛车，让人更具沉浸感和更能体验游戏特色的，还要数各种角色扮演脚本。

在一个“帮助失忆女友恢复记忆”的脚本中，按照原本的游戏发展安排，男主角原本要给我做拌饭作为午餐，我尝试与其进行了自然语言对话，比如说“给我下碗面”之类的，对方会回答家里没有相关食材，现在只能做拌饭之类的，以相对符合逻辑的语言来应对无法满足要求，而不是像传统模拟游戏那样基本上把玩家的选择固定在特定的几个选择之中。

当然，Smart Zoi 系统由于本地部署的语言模型参数无法跟市面上正经的 AI 大模型相提并论，所以多问几句还是很容易陷入循环，想要推进故事基本上还是得跟着脚本的安排走，去完成一个又一个的指定任务，但相对于以往已经是相当大的体验进步。

上面这种基于“恋人关系”打造的脚本还算给了 AI 系统较大的发挥空间，另一个“便利店打工”的脚本则可以看做是“画布小镇”任务制系统的演示，主角的基本活动范围停留在一家便利店内，任务列表活像一部“便利店打工日志”，有打扫门店、清理桌子、整理物品等等，当然你也可以跟来来往往的 AI 顾客进行互动，观察他们的喜怒哀乐。

试玩 DEMO 里的各种脚本均来自官方和玩家制作，客观来讲一定程度上展示了“画布小镇”功能的内容深度，给玩家留下很大的想象空间。除此之外，AI 系统的另一大特色便是成长性，随着积累的数据越来越丰富，在可预见的将来有很大可能性可以为玩家提供更完善的生活体验。

《inZOI》制作人金亨俊、助理李承珉访谈

活动当天我们还有幸采访到《inZOI》的制作人金亨俊以及助理李承珉先生。金制作人在 TapTap 玩聚节活动现场进行了舞台分享以及线下签名等活动，听取了来自玩家的直接反馈，其中一些让他十分感慨。

以下是此次访谈的主要内容。

—— 看到您在官网上有公布一个更新 Roadmap，从中可以发现这款游戏在过去一年经历了较大规模的系统重做，能否介绍一下这次现场提供的试玩 DEMO 想要展示的迭代重点是什么？

金亨俊：重点一共有两个。

第一是多人联机（Multiplay）相关内容。作为人生模拟类游戏，观察他人的生活是非常重要的。第二，之前我们在线上跟用户交流时发现，现在AI技术发展飞快，我们可以把它加入到生活中，让角色们能够生活在一起，产生链接。以上两点是本次现场版本中，想要跟大家重点表现的内容。

—— 制作人在之前的分享中提到这个版本“表面上看东西不多，但底下在翻地基”。如果用一个玩家进游戏马上能感觉到的变化来解释“这版值不值得更新”，可否举一个例子来说明？

金亨俊：我个人还是希望从联机功能这个角度给大家做推荐，这样大家会觉得更新的这版是值得的。因为基于 AI 系统制作的 NPC、以及一些主要内容的更新，还有我们今天在现场给大家体验到的一些内容，其实到最终正式上市还需要一点时间，所以联机这部分其实是我最推荐的。

另外我还想重点推荐一个内容。因为人生是平凡的，但我们平凡的人生中还是会有一些发光的瞬间，因此我们上线了“画布小镇”这个功能，也是希望大家在玩人生模拟类游戏的时候可以把自己重要的瞬间记录下来。举一个例子，比如有人向我告白，我可以通过“画布小镇”把这样的瞬间记录下来变成独立的脚本关卡。

—— 想请问一下，抢先体验版（EA）上线已经一年多，现在回头看，您觉得当初选择抢先体验模式的决定是否正确？假如说可以晚点上线，把这个产品打磨得再好一点，局面会不会更好？

金亨俊：这个问题我非常熟悉，这是一个非常好的问题。因为我在不同的国家接受采访时，都会有记者朋友提出这个问题，而我的答案是并不后悔。

这个游戏带给了我非常大的惊喜，惊喜点在于它做起来真的很难。我有 30 年的游戏从业经历，但这么难做的游戏也是首次遇到。今天在签名会的现场，有很多用户向我反馈说“还是蛮好的”，这让我十分欣慰。所以到目前为止，我并没有后悔过上线抢先体验版本这件事，我觉得这个版本在合适的时间上线与大家见面了。

而且今天在现场签名会的时候，有一位玩了我们抢先版比较深入的朋友，提出了一个非常细节的问题，说某个画面有一道白线非常影响沉浸式体验，问我们能不能改一下。这就说明，抢先上线虽然不完美，但它完成了，并且得到了反馈。包括在用户层面，大家也是能够理解和接受这个事情的，这真的非常重要，我们可以跟玩家们一起把它创造得越来越好。

—— 刚刚上线不久的 9 月 3 号的更新，你们不堆新内容，专门把 Zoi“半夜不睡觉、乱坐椅子、有车不会自己开”等等这种日常搞笑的行为修正了一遍。你们自己内部测试的时候，大家更喜欢哪个？觉得哪个更好笑？

金亨俊：这种行为在游戏里称之为自由行动类。其实解决这个问题比较难，我们团队内部用了非常大的心血去解决。为了游戏的稳定性，如果让 Zoi 的行动太过于完美，会让它们看起来非常机械、无聊；如果让它们看起来像傻瓜一样自由行动，又会让它们看起来像个“小傻子”。

我们整体团队的意见是，让它控制在一定的比例以内，既不会那么机械无聊，但同时又不会让它像个傻子一样，保持一点“活人感”，让大家觉得游戏更有活力。

—— 加深“生活模拟的深度”一直是制作组的目标，不过这个概念本身比较抽象，能否请制作人进一步阐释一下到底什么是“加深生活模拟的深度”？

金亨俊：我也承认，“加深生活模拟的深度”是比较抽象的概念。因为相对于其他游戏，比如对战类的最后要剩下一个人，或者是有明确的关卡必须活下去等等，我们的内容确实有点抽象。

在游戏发售初期我其实是有点担心的。就像我今天在现场舞台上跟大家分享的一样，我们这款游戏可以让用户玩家体验一下在现实生活中没有办法做到的事情。比如说现实生活中是比较“I”（内向）的人，但是心里想变“E”（外向）的时候，你可以在游戏世界里变得很“E”，去体验一些你在现实生活中想体验但没有机会体验的东西。

游戏本身带给用户的，就是让你在假想的世界里做到你在现实世界里做不到的事情。用户玩家在假想的游戏世界里获得一种勇气，就相当于是提前为现实生活做的一种实习。

其实很多人都误会我了，觉得我做分享游刃有余，其实不是这样的。刚才站在台上的时候，我觉得我的灵魂已经离开我的身体了（笑）。每次面对记者朋友们的时候我也会非常紧张。当然，我在游戏当中就会游刃有余，这也是游戏给我现实生活中的一种勇气。

—— 能不能透露一下主机版本目前的进展？

金亨俊：开发基本已经结束了，目前还在做一些优化，争取在明年上半年左右，或者更早一点让它跟大家见面。它应该会和《inZOI》的正式版本差不多同一时间推出，也会成为让大家不会失望的游戏。我们还是想把它的功能做得更加完善一点，所以并没有像 PC 版一样有一个提前的抢先体验版本。

—— 刚才您提到了体验上的变化，有一些 AI NPC 我也在试玩 DEMO 中跟它们进行了一些聊天。除了我们看到的 AI 对话以外，它们还有没有一些我们看不到的作用？尤其是在NPC交互方面？

金亨俊：关于 AI NPC 这部分其实带给了我非常大的惊喜。因为在游戏当中 Zoi 的很多活动、行动本来是事前已经预设好了的，但 AI 的出现会让它们有点像人一样，会看眼色，自己去计算得失然后再行动。

比如说在我们的内容里，如果出现了两名男士追求一位女士，有一位男士睡着了，另外一个男士自己就会开始算计，想着我的竞争者睡着了，这是我告白的好机会，会见缝插针地表现自己。起初这样的内容带给我的其实是类似惊吓的情绪，但同样也是一种惊喜。

还有一个令我印象深刻的片段是跟 AI 借钱，结果没有一个人借给我，最后还是游戏里的女儿借给我的。这是我们事先没有计划的事情，AI Zoi 做出了意想之外的举动，因为这些行动都是经过计算的，仔细想想好像也符合常理。

—— 刚才您提到了明年正式版的相关问题，想问一下正式版本跟今天的版本会有哪些差异？哪些内容要补完？在您的想象中正式版应该是一个什么样的形态？

金亨俊：与其说抢先版和正式版中间的绝对差异点，我更希望分享的是，从一年前的抢先版上市以来，我们一直在不断更新的内容。玩家可以游泳、建房子、种地，这些都是不断增加的内容。

计划明年上半年上线的正式版本，相当于我们把所有的更新内容放在了正式的版本里面，包括衣服的选择也会增加到上百套的样子。其实就相当于是从一个不太完美的版本变成了一个完成度非常高的版本，可以这么去理解。我们在玩抢先版的时候能感觉到有些地方让玩家感觉不那么自然，在正式版本中我们也会克服这个问题。

—— 我看到《inZOI》目前版本已经有了对 Mod 的支持，在 EA 阶段就把精力花在 Mod 支持上会不会有点早？制作组是怎么考虑的？这是否能有效提升目前玩家的活跃度？

金亨俊：在抢先体验版本里面支持 Mod 这个事情让我十分“后悔”（笑）。虽然我刚才说了后悔，因为我的精力要放到两个方向上，这是非常分散精力的事情，而且我也是第一次做支持 Mod 的游戏。

但是通过 Mod 这件事情，也给我们的游戏带来了一些不一样的东西。比如说我们最近收到一个玩家发过来的关于婚纱内容创作，他说正是因为有了 Mod 功能才得以完成，这时候我就会觉得 Mod 还是挺有用的。总结起来一句话：虽然做得后悔，过程也比较艰难，但是感觉效果也还不错。

大家利用 Mod 功能其实也让游戏的可玩性变强了。比如最近有一个打篮球的相关内容，目前在本作的世界里打篮球都只有一些比较简单的动作，但是用 Mod 强化之后，它可以变成一个竞技项目，可以记分什么的，所以我认为 Mod 是可以强化体验的一个东西。

还有，之所以会觉得做完之后效果很好，主要是因为我每个星期都会跟玩家沟通，大家会发给我一些用 Mod 做的内容，总数有时候高达 400 个，如果让我们的制作组来做，那是完全不可能实现的工作量，但现在我们可以跟玩家一起用 Mod 去不断完善《inZOI》，我觉得这是很好的事情。所以，我虽然最开始说了后悔在抢先版上线 Mod，但我作为正式回答，我是不后悔的。

—— 因为刚才回答的时候已经提到了正式版和抢先版的内容差距，想请问一下会不会有一些大家现在不知道，或者意想不到的惊喜内容在正式版上线的时候？

金亨俊：有惊喜内容。就因为是惊喜内容，所以今天不能回答你（笑）。准确来说有两个惊喜，其中第一个我们刚才在舞台活动中已经向玩家们宣布了，就是会支持养猫的功能，这是其中一个惊喜。因为这个功能也是很多玩家向我们提出的诉求，我们一直以来没有满足大家，所以在正式版本的时候决定满足大家。

另一个则要等待正式版上线的时候才会公布了（笑）。

—— 这次来上海参加 TapTap 玩聚节活动，在线下跟中国内地玩家见面，制作人最想问中国玩家的问题是什么？

金亨俊：无论是在中国、韩国，所谓东亚国家，好像还是竞技类的游戏占主流。但是我今天在现场看到大家的反响非常好，我也从中获得了勇气和力量。我最想询问大家的其实很简单，就是我们在《inZOI》里面放什么样的内容，大家会喜欢、会感到高兴呢？

这也是我和我的制作组们经常聊的话题，制作组也会问我，我们制作什么样的内容，放什么样的功能玩家会喜欢呢？

我今天在现场有公开联机相关的内容，这其实背后有一个小故事：有一个中国的网红发邮件给我，他说为了中国的玩家，请一定要做联机，所以我决定做联机。

所以大家如果有希望在《inZOI》里看到的东西，请一定要联系我们。

—— 刚才您开场说《inZOI》这个游戏很难做，我们也一直在想，因为生活模拟这个品类确实很难。这么多年，一说生活模拟就是《模拟人生》系列，其他的游戏很难出头。您作为制作这个品类的开发者，肯定也对《模拟人生》系列做了很深入的研究，对于这个品类，您能够从《模拟人生》上学到什么？

金亨俊：首先，我觉得《模拟人生》系列是非常大胆的游戏，因为它二十年如一日的在进行不断的开发和研究，这一点是非常大胆和厉害的。《模拟人生》的团队也曾到过我们公司，为我们进行了非常好的分享。

而说起想要借鉴的部分，首先《模拟人生》系列幽默、搞笑的特色十分突出，而《inZOI》目前给人的感觉更偏向真实系，一旦游戏走这条路线，玩家就会反馈说玩起来总感觉哪里有点尴尬（笑）。

前段时间《模拟人生》系列有一位开发者在接受访问的时候曾经提到：“《inZOI》幽默不足”，负责采访的那位记者的我也跟他打过交道，看到这句话的时候我感觉真的很有意思。

我在开发《inZOI》之前其实就对《模拟人生》系列的开发团队十分敬佩，做了《inZOI》之后那种敬佩感愈发强烈，因为二十年如一日的不断开发、研究，真的不是一件容易的事情。

—— 这一次来到 TapTap 玩聚节，有没有遇到一些比较好玩的经历或者印象比较深刻的事情？

金亨俊：首先，最惊讶的是有一位玩家可以全程用韩语跟我交流，他说得太好了，我一度怀疑他是不是也来自韩国。第二个印象深刻的是，有一位玩家指出了某个画面上的问题，并且说让我们赶紧修改，这种单刀直入的表述真的很有意思（笑）。

但最让我感动的是，很多玩家在签名会的时候跟我说：“请你们要一直做下去，要一直更新下去，要一直坚持下去。”这让我非常感动。

我之前觉得《inZOI》这种人生模拟类的游戏，在亚洲来说没有那么大众化。但是今天在 TapTap 玩聚节这个活动上，我得到了很多的反馈和力量，所以我将满怀着感动和惊喜回到韩国去。

title: 《怪物猎人 荒野：凌越》「重弩炮」武器介绍视频

title: 《暗黑破坏神5》先导预告
author: Simon You
text:

title: 《魔兽争霸3 重铸版》「被遗忘的王国」预告

text:
战火早已肆虐
在世界奠定之前，战火早已肆虐。《魔兽争霸3》二十年来首次推出全新升级，邀请玩家重返经典RTS战场。《魔兽争霸3 重铸版》「被遗忘的王国」推出全新可游玩战役，让玩家从罗德隆的末日展开旅程，亲自见证幽暗城声名大噪之前的起源故事。见证《魔兽世界》时代来临前的关键事件。「被遗忘的王国」将考验你的战略能力，让你再度面对死亡。与数十年来的传奇角色还有全新英雄并肩作战，一同永远改变这个世界。

title: 《怪物猎人 荒野：凌越》「长枪」武器介绍视频
author: Simon You

title: Heroes of the Storm gets first new hero after supposed death and 6 year wait
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
It's rare that a MOBA comes out, rarer that it manages to stick around, and perhaps rarest of all that it surges back to life after years on the backburner. While Heroes of the Storm never quite had its lights turned off , the constant downpour of new stuff you'd expect in a live service game did wind down. Until now.
At today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, it was announced that Xal'atath, the Harbinger of the Void, will be arriving in the long-dormant MOBA as a new hero—its first since Hogger was released all the way back in 2020. It's the first truly substantial update since 2022, as the game has only received light-touch balance passes and bug fixes since Blizzard announced a shift to maintenance mode.
If you're unfamiliar, Xal'atath is a character from World of Warcraft's Legion expansion who started as a gnawing voice tucked away in the weapon slots of Shadow Priest players. More recently, she's become the villainous face of the current Midnight expansion.
It was also announced that another new hero would be revealed at some point in the future.
Xal'atath will arrive on the game's PTR this Monday, with a full release scheduled for Sep. 28. Follow the rest of today's Blizzcon news on our liveblog .

title: New StarCraft game is an open world shooter coming in 2030
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
The rumors were true: A new StarCraft game is incoming. It's just called "StarCraft," it's an open world shooter, and Blizzard doesn't plan to release it until 2030.
The game was revealed at BlizzCon with a cinematic trailer, but no gameplay was shown, which isn't surprising given how far off it is.
The trailer showcases the training and gearing up of a Terran Dominion Space Marine, with an inspirational speech about killing Zerg over the montage. It ends with our anonymous hero doing battle with the Zerg, then a cut to his broken and bloody armor getting cleaned and repaired without him back on a Dominion ship.
This isn't the first time Blizzard has attempted an action-forward StarCraft spinoff. StarCraft Ghost was a legendary, Duke Nukem Forever-tier bit of vaporware that Blizzard teased, demoed, and reworked for much of the 2000s. Its titular Ghost, Nova, eventually got the consolation prize of being a secondary character in StarCraft 2 and the protagonist of a few tie-in novels. This new shooter appears to borrow little, if anything, from that earlier effort by Blizzard.
There was some speculation before the show that Blizzard might announce a new StarCraft RTS, but there's no sign of such a project, if it exists. It'll be interesting to see how fans react, as well as the esports scene. Excited for new StarCraft anything? Disappointed that it's not an RTS?

title: Blizzard announces animated Diablo show coming to Netflix
author: Ted Litchfield
text:
At BlizzCon 2026, Blizzard president Johanna Faries took to the stage to announce that a Diablo animated series is in production with Netflix.
The announcement was light on details, and did not come with a trailer or release window, but Faries did note "great discussions being had" regarding adaptations of Overwatch and Warcraft. Faries also allowed that Blizzard's other properties could see similar treatments.
“After decades of bringing entire universes to life through our games, we’re partnering with some creative powerhouses to tell even more stories beyond gaming across new screens," Blizzard wrote in a press release about the project. "A new animated series set in the world of ‘Diablo’ is in development with Netflix. More details will be shared in the future, but this is only the beginning, with even more taking shape across our universes.”
It feels like the early 2020s gold rush of streaming TV videogame adaptations is cooling down—RIP, Halo show. But we also know what's worked really well. Netflix's animated adaptations of Cyberpunk and League of Legends, Edgerunners and Arkane respectively, are huge and much-beloved, with reaches well beyond their respective playerbases.
An animated adaptation from the same outfit behind these other hit gaming adaptations strikes me as a slam dunk. We'll have to wait and see if the goliath partnership is able to land the plane.

An animated adaptation from the same outfit behind these other hit gaming adaptations strikes me as a slam dunk. We'll have to wait and see if the goliath partnership is able to land the plane.

title: Diablo 5 is coming in 2029
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
The biggest surprise of BlizzCon might be Diablo 5, which Blizzard announced will release in spring 2029, six years after the 2023 launch of Diablo 4.
The sequel will take place about a century after the events of Diablo 4. Sanctuary is no longer on the verge of apocalypse in Diablo 5: It's been fully apolcalpyted. The Lord of Terror—aka Diablo himself, absent in Diablo 4—is back, and he won.
"The heroes are gone, Sanctuary has fallen, and Diablo has won," declared Diablo 4 director Joe Shely. "For the first time, you won't be fighting to stop Diablo from taking Sanctuary. You'll enter a world where he already has. There are no towns or safe places waiting to protect you."
There's not a ton to go on in the trailer, but it is, fittingly, dark and grim: Everything's on fire, grubby peasant guys proselytize on behalf of the victorious demons, and angels are getting crucified. After the title drop, we get a brief view of the titular Diablo himself, out of focus and wreathed in fire.
2029 is still a ways off, but it's nevertheless surprising to hear news of a new numbered Diablo sequel. Given Diablo 4's live servicey shape, I expected another expansion roadmap rather than a full-blown sequel.
For comparison, there was a 12 year wait between Diablos 2 and 3, and an 11-year gap between the initial launches of 3 and 4, both about double the projected wait between 4 and 5.
Development times have been trending longer in the industry, not shorter, and I'm curious how Diablo players will respond to what would usually be regarded as pretty great news—do you think Blizzard should have stuck with D4 as a platform instead of already starting on a sequel? Sound off in the comments.
Regarding Diablo 4, Blizzard did announce that the Amazon class is coming, and talked about the next season, an anniversary celebration looking back at Diablo's past, but didn't announce a new expansion.

title: Hearthstone just got its first new class in four years: Warcraft's fire-breathing panda Monk
author: Justin Wagner
text:
At today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, it was announced that Hearthstone will receive a third post-launch class—the game's first since the Death Knight released in 2022. It's none other than the Monk, a class with origins you can trace all the way back to Warcraft 3's pandaren brewmaster.
Represented by the playable Chen Stormstout, the Monk will get a full reveal next year. While not World of Warcraft's most popular class, it is perhaps its silliest, which fits Hearthstone's cartoonish sensibilities to a T. After this point, the Evoker will be the only class from Blizzard's titan MMO that isn't represented in card game form (unless you count the Night Elf Mohawk ).
The expansion coming in the meantime, Reign of the Black Empire, is another old god-themed extravaganza, complete with bouncy electronic grooves all over the trailer. No goofy lyrics this time around, but what can you do?
It also comes with a new keyword, "assemble," which allows players to merge cards for ludicrous combos. It sounds like the sort of shenanigan-magnet Hearthstone is known for.
Reign of the Black Empire will land on Oct. 10, with the Monk class arriving March 2027. Follow the rest of today's Blizzcon news on our liveblog .

title: Blizzard just dropped a new Warcraft 3 campaign, the first in 23 years
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
For the first time since its Frozen Throne expansion in 2003, Warcraft 3 is getting a new campaign. Or got one, more accurately: Blizzard just announced at BlizzCon that it's dropping the expansion today.
In a pre-brief before BlizzCon's opening ceremony, we learned that Warcraft 3: Forsaken Kingdom is a two-part campaign for Warcraft 3: Reforged, the 2020 remaster of the 2002 RTS. It begins with a prologue covering the story of Arthas, the primary antagonist in World of Warcraft's Wrath of the Lich King expansion.
The main portion of the campaign following that prologue regards the Undercity, the capital of the undead Forsaken Kingdom, where we'll find the likes of Sylvanas, Putress, and the Scarlet Crusade.
Alongside the new expansion, Warcraft 3 Reforged is getting a free 3.0 update. Forsaken Kingdom is available now for $30 on Battle.net .
Reforged was not a popular remaster of Warcraft 3 when it first launched in 2020, but a new update and surprise expansion could go a long way toward rehabilitating the project. 2026 is now firmly the year of the surprise expansion to an old game: Forsaken Kingdom joins Thief Remastered: The Tarnished Mirror , Quake: Dawn of the Machine , and The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in this strange new category.

title: Overwatch's newest hero is a robo-vampire, and reworks are on the way for Roadhog and Sombra
author: Justin Wagner
text:
As was revealed in today's Blizzcon opening ceremony, Overwatch's newest hero is on the way: Doctrine, a vampire with a cyborg arm and mechanical bats. He was debuted via a story trailer that reveals a connection to Doomfist, the game's resident punch man.
A hero trial is active now, in case you want to try him out, and it will remain live through the weekend. While his exact release date has not been announced, the game is keeping up a rapid pace for the addition of new heroes—D. Mon released just last month on August 11.
That's not all Blizzard teased, though. Reworks are on the way for two of the game's prickliest characters, Sombra and Roadhog, both of whom have already received countless tweaks since they joined the game. Precise details weren't shared during the opening ceremony, but Sombra's going to become a support and Roadhog should be less "frustrating" to deal with.
The new act of the game's year-long story will bring a new map as well—Grímsvötn—and the next Overwatch Spotlight teasing what's to follow is scheduled for Feb. 2027. The last time one of those happened, five heroes were revealed and released all in one go. Time will tell if something that huge is set to happen again.

title: The WoW 'Classic+' rumors were true: World of Warcraft: Forever promises to be another timeline's version of the MMO
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
The rumored game known to World of Warcraft fans as "Classic Plus" is real, and it has a proper name now—World of Warcraft: Forever is a new branch of the MMO that once again resets the clock to 2004, the year WoW first launched.
But unlike WoW: Classic, the goal of WoW: Forever isn't just to take a trip back to the MMO's origins to relive those heady early years. WoW: Forever will explore new parts of Azeroth, telling stories that weren't told during the MMO's original progression.
PC Gamer was briefed on the announcement before the reveal at the BlizzCon Opening Ceremony. Here are the biggest takeaways:
WoW: Forever will be set in the first year of WoW with a level cap of 60 "for the foreseeable future"
New stuff won't just be for max level players; it will span all levels
Three new zones
"Several" existing zones overhauled, "filling in the blank spaces of the vanilla map"
Nine new dungeons
Two new raids
New race: Skyborne Elves
New race/class combos: The trailer seems to show a Forsaken paladin, dwarf shaman, and orc mage
It's a strategy reminiscent of Old School RuneScape, which treats the 2006 version of the MMO as a jumping-off point rather than a specimen to be preserved. It's worked out well for Jagex: OSRS is bigger now than it was during the original run.
The existence of three different Worlds of Warcraft might risk diluting the playerbase, but if any MMO is big enough to sustain three official forks—and if any studio has the resources to support them—it's probably WoW and Blizzard.
WoW: Forever will be playable at BlizzCon this weekend, and a beta starts this Thursday. The full launch isn't far away either: Forever is set to release on November 4. World of Warcraft: Forever is covered by the pre-existing WoW subscription, but upgrade packs with features like the Skyborne race are available on Battle.net starting at $30.

title: No more Diablo 4 expansions are planned, but there's 'a lot of room' for more storytelling in the lead-up to Diablo 5
author: Tyler Wilde
text:
Diablo is returning: At BlizzCon today, Blizzard announced that Diablo 5 will be set a century after Diablo 4 in a Sanctuary that has succumbed to the Lord of Terror, Diablo himself.
That's not until 2029, though. In the meantime, Blizzard will continue the story of Diablo 4 with seasons, but no more expansions are currently planned for the game.
"We're all focused on [Diablo 4] seasons and getting to Diablo 5," said Diablo game director Brent Gibson in an interview with PC Gamer at BlizzCon. "We feel like we told the Story of Hatred. We had a great conclusion with Lord of Hatred with what we have with Mephisto, and we are moving towards telling the Story of Terror."
Even if no more expansions are currently planned, the Diablo 4 story isn't over. Given the premise of Diablo 5, Blizzard now has to bring about the apocalypse, and it sounds like we'll see how that plays out in the upcoming seasons. Nothing's set in stone, though.
"The events of Diablo 5 happen 100 years after everything that's happening with Diablo 4, and so that gives us a lot of room to kind of still ride the wave with all the fans on where the story can go as we make our way there," said Gibson. "So continuity is something that we're really excited about, but we don't necessarily have a perfect picture on exactly where that's going to go because we want to see how fans are reacting season to season."
I also asked whether we can expect a Path of Exile/Path of Exile 2 situation, where a live service game and its sequel end up running concurrently, or if we should expect dev resources to fully switch over to Diablo 5 after it launches.
Gibson indicated that support for Diablo 4 isn't going away so long as people are playing it, pointing to the continued support for Diablo 2: Resurrected, which got a new class earlier this year, as evidence of Blizzard's commitment to the whole Diablo "universe."
"I think you can expect that—you know, Diablo 4 players, they love the game, there's tons of them out there," said Gibson. "We're continuing to support the game for a very long time."
It's unclear what that support will look like, but Diablo 5 is a ways off yet and it sounds like plans are expected to evolve with feedback. Diablo 3 won't necessarily be the template, but it's currently in a kind of time loop, cycling through its biggest seasons.
You can catch up on more BlizzCon announcements in our recap of the Opening Ceremony . Tyler Colp has also collected the big details about Diablo 5 revealed during a breakout panel.

title: Diablo 5 gameplay details from BlizzCon: More classes than ever before, procedurally-generated dungeons, and Diablo 2-style loot
author: Tyler Colp
text:
Diablo 5 is shaping up to be very different from Diablo 4. The sequel is set a hundred years after Diablo 4 in the aftermath of Diablo (the demon)'s apocalyptic destruction of Sanctuary, and it's going to bring fundamental changes to combat, classes, and loot.
Several Diablo 5 developers took the stage today at BlizzCon 2026 to talk about their vision for the game, noting that everything is still a work-in-progress and subject to change between now and the spring 2029 release window.
A lot of Diablo 5's biggest changes feel like a response to both player reception of Diablo 4—specifically what it lacked compared to previous games and competitors, like Path of Exile—and the much darker setting, which Blizzard is "doubling down" on.
The campaign begins several years after a golden age for Sanctuary, right as it falls into the hands of the big bad Diablo. Like Mephisto in Diablo 4, Diablo will be a full character as opposed to just a boss you fight at the end. Much of the story will involve restoring the western continent and Westmarch, the most iconic location in the series, from its ravaged state.
Here's what I gleaned from the 30-minute panel:
Diablo 5 will go back to procedurally-generated dungeons and open-world regions that will change every time you return to them
Towns won't exist; instead, you'll have a caravan of NPCs you'll meet throughout the story (one of your buddies will be a treasure goblin)
Sidequests will all come from the people in your caravan
The demon hunter and monk classes are returning
New classes will show up too, including the plague knight: a heavily-armored class that spreads disease around the battlefield
It will launch with more classes than every Diablo game has launched with combined
Items will have tiers, starting simple and growing in complexity as you progress
Belts and set items are coming back
Items will take up multiple inventory slots based on their type, like Diablo 2
The team is experimenting with items that require certain stat thresholds—which is also reminiscent of Diablo 2
Blizzard said we can expect to hear regular updates on the development of Diablo 5 starting next year, and emphasized that it will be changing things as it goes along based on player feedback.

title: Playing RTS with a controller? Total War: Warhammer 40,000 dev says it 'really does work' in their game: 'I think we've landed in a really solid spot'
author: Jody Macgregor
text:
The kids who grew up playing StarCraft on Nintendo 64 must have thumbs of steel. With the exception of a handful of games designed specifically for consoles like Herzog Zwei and Halo Wars, the RTS has not been a genre that's played well with controllers. It remains the heartland of the mouse and keyboard.
And yet, Total War developer Creative Assembly is committed to releasing Total War: Warhammer 40,000 on consoles. The studio's battle product owner Dave Petry told TechRadar at Gamescom he thinks it's a "myth" that controller support doesn't work for the RTS genre and that they've "landed something that really does work."
"Because yes, obviously, controllers are your primary method for using consoles, but it's just an input method. It's an accessibility tool, right? It's how you want to play or how you would like to play, and so we've always wanted to be able to bring that experience to people who want to use a gamepad."
Creative Assembly co-developed Halo Wars 2, which Petry cited as a specific example of a "really strong implementation of controller and RTS," though it benefits from its simplicity. When the more fiddly Age of Empires 2 came out on Xbox it had to have automated villagers who would gather resources and construct farms based on your preset preference, because that kind of micromanagement is a bit of a faff with twin sticks.
Of course, the Total War games leave building and tech trees for the turn-based side of the campaign, and it's only battles that happen in real-time. While the finer points of cycle-charging or drawing missile fire by marching your lord back and forth might not feel as nice with a controller, I'm sure it would be possible.
"I think we are learning that we can do this right, and yeah, it's definitely something that we're all keen to keep evolving as we ship and work on it," Petry said. "I think we've landed in a really solid spot. I think we're quite proud of where we are when it comes to the technical side of things as well."

It's how you want to play or how you would like to play, and so we've always wanted to be able to bring that experience to people who want to use a gamepad."

Creative Assembly co-developed Halo Wars 2, which Petry cited as a specific example of a "really strong implementation of controller and RTS," though it benefits from its simplicity. When the more fiddly Age of Empires 2 came out on Xbox it had to have automated villagers who would gather resources and construct farms based on your preset preference, because that kind of micromanagement is a bit of a faff with twin sticks.

Of course, the Total War games leave building and tech trees for the turn-based side of the campaign, and it's only battles that happen in real-time. While the finer points of cycle-charging or drawing missile fire by marching your lord back and forth might not feel as nice with a controller, I'm sure it would be possible.

"I think we are learning that we can do this right, and yeah, it's definitely something that we're all keen to keep evolving as we ship and work on it," Petry said. "I think we've landed in a really solid spot. I think we're quite proud of where we are when it comes to the technical side of things as well."

title: Why is Blizzard still announcing games years ahead of release? 'We want to convey confidence in some of our biggest bets coming forward'
author: Jody Macgregor
text:
Reactions to the StarCraft trailer shown at BlizzCon this year seem pretty universal. Initial excitement, immediately deflated when the words "STARCRAFT RETURNS 2030" appeared at the end. (The fact it's going to be an "open world shooter" didn't help.) The surprise announcement of Diablo 5 coming in 2029 seems odd too. There were 11 years between Diablo 3 and Diablo 4, but the gap between that and Diablo 5 will only be six.
Announcing videogames more than a couple of years ahead of release feels like a relic of the past. Everyone assumes games will get delayed anyway, and viewers are adding "at the earliest" as a footnote. Saying something is just around the corner earns goodwill, while saying it's three or four years away tells us to gear up for a hype cycle we'll be tired of before the actual game materializes—if it ever does.
Blizzard president Johanna Faries spoke to Bloomberg ahead of BlizzCon. "We want to convey confidence in some of our biggest bets coming forward," she said on this topic. "We're a Blizzard that's going to ship, and ship big, and ship on time, and all hands on deck to set those projects up for success."
Blizzard has so far managed to avoid being hit by Microsoft's recent layoffs, but more are coming next year . It's a good time to make sure everyone knows you've got loads of exciting projects in the works and you need as many staff as possible to make them a reality.
While Faries didn't discuss the possibility of job losses, she did say she wanted BlizzCon to be "a sort of oasis, a moment for real joy" for both Blizzard's staff and its fans, and that she was "completely focused on creating as healthy a Blizzard as possible".
"Preserving that has been my ultimate focus," Faries said. "The unique special sauce that is Blizzard both culturally and creatively. And to the extent that we can perform well for Microsoft, I think that should be seen as a mutual win."
